title: feat: delivery agent dispatch, UI cleanup and dev tooling sync
body:
## Summary

- Complete delivery agent WhatsApp dispatch flow (modeling, dispatch engine, webhook, admin UI)
- Remove unused components: DeliveryStatusModal.tsx, ActiveRequestOverlay.tsx, delivery-status API route
- Simplify CartContent, ConfirmOrderContent, OrdersContent components
- Add dev/debug tooling and project config files
- Update .gitignore, switch-pharmacy API, DeliverySession model

## What a reviewer should know

- DeliveryStatusModal and ActiveRequestOverlay have been fully removed - confirm no other pages reference them before merging
- Merging will trigger a Vercel production redeploy

## Test plan
- [ ] Delivery agent dispatch flow end-to-end (WhatsApp notify on order)
- [ ] Confirm order flow still works after ConfirmOrderContent simplification
- [ ] Orders and cart pages render correctly
- [ ] No broken imports from removed components
